model.name: T-iframe-pinch: 2-finger pinch scales preview iframe content (0.25x-4x)
model.description: Wrap iframe in .preview-zoom-container with touch-action:none. 2-touch → capture initialPinchDist, compute scale = currentScale * (newDist/initialDist), clamp [0.25,4], apply transform:scale on iframe. No snap-back. Single-touch pan preserved.
